result.title: SAVIER: Source-Anchored Visual Inspection and Evidence-Guided Repair for Vietnamese Cultural Text-to-Image Generation
result.summary: We present SAVIER, a training-free, one-pass framework that repairs the depiction of a named Vietnamese cultural entity in a generated image while preserving the scene details requested by the user. The problem is hard because a plausible scene can miss the cues that identify the entity, and prompt-level refinement never inspects the image it produces. SAVIER starts from a Culture-TRIP expanded prompt; a Curator separates source-linked cultural cues from prompt-preservation requirements, a prompt-blind Observer describes the first image, and a Refiner turns the discrepancies into at most three positive instructions before one regeneration with the same seed and a fixed bank of reference photographs. On the 50 bilingual prompts of ViCuP, evaluated with SDXL and FLUX.1-dev against a frozen, human-verified visual contract, SAVIER raises contract fulfillment from 55.6 to 69.6 and from 59.1 to 67.3 over Culture-TRIP and raises CAIRE cultural relevance on FLUX.1-dev. A reference-only ablation that removes the agent repair shows that SAVIER's photographs account for most of the contract gain; the agent roles add country-level relevance on FLUX.1-dev without lowering adherence to the original prompt under the official VQAScore. Project page: https://oxyzgiahuy.github.io/savier/

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 SAVIER 框架：Curator 从扩写提示中分离需保留的场景要求与越南文化实体线索，不看提示的 Observer 描述首张生成图，Refiner 将差异转成至多三条正向指令后同种子重生成一次；在 ViCuP 上以 SDXL 与 FLUX.1-dev 评估并做参考图消融。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先独立看图→定位与目标线索的差异→生成修正指令」的单轮证据筛选与重生成流程，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 阶段的证据定位及贡献分配（消融显示增益主要来自参考照片而非 agent）提供可核查线索，但对象是图像生成而非 latent 推理状态。
